title: Indian ride-hailing app Rapido raised $240M led by Prosus as part of a broader primary and secondary financing transaction, valuing Rapido at $3B post-money (Pramugdha Mamgain/DealStreetAsia)
summary: Pramugdha Mamgain / DealStreetAsia: Indian ride-hailing app Rapido raised $240M led by Prosus as part of a broader primary and secondary financing transaction, valuing Rapido at $3B post-money — Ride-hailing platform Rapido, operated by Roppen Transportation Services Private Limited, on Friday announced that it has raised $240 million …
